instruction_suffix: Keep EVERYTHING else pixel-identical: same framing, same camera, same scale and position of every existing object, same line style and colors, same background.

edits.request: add a compact onboard computer unit: a small dark-grey box with a glowing teal status screen, mounted in the centre of the dashboard between the steering wheel and the open atlas on the passenger seat
roof antenna; cartridge in the onboard computer; lit instrument cluster; immobilizer with red LED; key fob with six buttons; amber idea lamp; VIN plate on the door pillar

warning triangle and chequered finish flag on the navigation screen; three voice buttons under it; timer dial by the rain sensor; magnifier, check marks and printouts on the atlas; orange cartridge on top of the onboard computer; amber lamp; accelerator pedal. MUST STAY UNCHANGED: gear lever, glovebox drawer with the blue book, steering wheel, key, cluster

load sticker, CB radio, fire extinguisher with first-aid kit and a column-diagram sign at the convoy; parking sensors and AWD badge on the rear of the main car; additive barrel and tuning-chip box by the tool cabinet; bypass fuel line with a red valve from the jerry can. MUST STAY UNCHANGED: cabin, pump, trailer, diagnostic cart, tool cabinet, cone
rear-view camera above the tow bar (taken into the result); door organizer (rejected: drawn over the diagnostic cart)

composite: step 4 result with the rear-camera region (1280-space box 980,283-1011,310, Gaussian edge 3 px) taken from step 5
